paragraphs: Rav Yeimar, son of Rav Hillel.
He is mentioned in [Zevachim 9a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.9a.15-16), and Rava responds to his words.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Hebrew brackets the name Yeimar. The passage gives the son of Rav Hillel’s objection and then Rava’s answer.
